title: Microsoft buries the Copilot+ PC brand and relaunches its assistant with autonomous agents and usage-based billing
summary: The company abandons its strategy of PCs with integrated AI to focus on a revamped Copilot with Autopilot mode and consumption-based pricing model.

title: Meta launches Muse, an AI agent platform that gives each user a cloud computer with Ubuntu
summary: The company deploys its bet on autonomous assistants that execute tasks on Linux virtual machines, accessible from its new camera-less smart glasses.

title: U.S. court upholds Anthropic as a risk in the Pentagon's supply chain for refusing to unlock Claude features
summary: The justice system endorses the national security risk label on the AI startup, which could veto its government contracts.

title: Google unveils Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS with voice cloning in 30 seconds and enterprise avatars in 97 languages
summary: The new generative audio model enables creating expressive voices and near-instant vocal replicas, while the enterprise version adds multilingual avatars.

title: Anthropic signs $11.6 billion cloud deal with Akamai, surpassing $500 billion in compute spending
summary: The AI startup secures massive inference capacity for its Claude models through a multi-year alliance with the content delivery network.

title: Intel projects its 14A process will match TSMC's A14 performance, while major tech companies evaluate its manufacturing
summary: The company projects competitive parity for 2026 and attracts interest from Apple, NVIDIA, AMD, Google, and Microsoft as an alternative to TSMC's limited capacity.

title: RTX 5090 power consumption spikes to 647 W and price exceeds $11,000 driven by massive DeepSeek demand in China
summary: NVIDIA's new flagship faces overheating issues with the 12VHPWR connector and global shortages due to the Chinese AI race.

title: DeepSeek drives high-end GPU demand in China and revolutionizes healthcare sector with open AI models
summary: The Chinese model monopolizes RTX 5090 stock and leads a wave of medical applications positioning the country as a digital health powerhouse.

title: Tesla begins trial production of its AI5 chip and accelerates heavy transport electrification after a decade of delays
summary: The fifth-generation processor manufactured by Samsung and the Semi truck mark the brand's definitive advance in autonomous driving and electric logistics.

title: Analysts call for AMD investigation over 'betrayal' after detecting restricted chips in China; company denies direct sales and blames distributor diversions
summary: An export-controlled RFSoC radar appears in Chinese projects at bargain prices, sparking accusations of U.S. sanctions evasion.

title: Noctua develops air cooling for 2,000 W chips via microchannels in alliance with Forced Physics
summary: The Austrian specialist breaks the kilowatt-per-air barrier, offering an alternative to liquid cooling in high-density data centers.

title: Qualcomm brings contextual AI to headphones and releases native Linux support for its Snapdragon X2 processors
summary: The manufacturer bets on AI agents in audio devices that understand the user's environment and facilitates development on open platforms.

title: Google tests orbital data centers with TPU chips and solar power, first step toward space computing
summary: The experiment deploys four AI accelerators and 1,000 watts of solar panels in orbit to validate the feasibility of extraterrestrial infrastructure.

title: China achieves 70% EV charges in under 5 minutes as Saudi Arabia enters the electric car race
summary: China's ultra-fast infrastructure leaves the U.S. behind and the Saudi kingdom abandons futuristic megaprojects to compete in electric mobility.

title: Disney+ raises price again and approaches 20 euros monthly in Europe
summary: The streaming service applies a new rate increase that also affects Hulu, raising the cost of the bundled package.

title: Swarms of OpenAI agents have been storming public databases for months seeking dark data to train models
summary: The company's automated crawlers massively access online repositories without apparent permission, generating concern over the use of others' resources.

title: A map of Flock surveillance cameras reveals massive locations and the company tries to remove it after jailing an innocent woman for 13 days
summary: A single erroneous data point from the license plate recognition system triggered an unjust arrest, exposing the opacity and reach of the private surveillance network.
